ab.description: Migration mode unsigned direction $\alpha_H$ in radians.

ae.description: Elongation mode signed direction $\alpha_E$ in radians. The direction longitudinal crests elongate.

at.description: Migration signed direction $\alpha_T$ in radians. The direction transverse crests migrate.

ao.description: Oblique signed direction $\alpha_O$ in radians. The direction oblique dune crests elongate.

rdpa.description: Direction of the time-averaged flat-bed flux vector, $\arg \sum n q e^{i\theta}$, radians CCW from east, direction of transport.

dpm.description: Time-averaged flat-bed saturated flux magnitude, $DP = \sum n q / \sum n$ over all speed and direction bins, in m$^2$/s.

rdpm.description: Magnitude of the time-averaged flat-bed flux vector, $RDP = |\sum n q e^{i\theta}| / \sum n$, in m$^2$/s.

qnlb.description: Net along-crest migration-mode flux $\langle Q_{\parallel}(\alpha_H)\rangle$ in m$^2$/s.

qncb.description: Net across-crest migration-mode flux $\langle Q_{\bot}(\alpha_H)\rangle$ in m$^2$/s.

qalb.description: Absolute along-crest migration-mode flux $\langle |Q_{\parallel}(\alpha_H)|\rangle$ in m$^2$/s.

qacb.description: Absolute across-crest migration-mode flux $\langle |Q_{\bot}(\alpha_H)|\rangle$ in m$^2$/s.

qnle.description: Net along-crest elongation-mode flux $\langle Q_{\parallel}(\alpha_E)\rangle$ in m$^2$/s.

qale.description: Absolute along-crest elongation-mode flux $\langle |Q_{\parallel}(\alpha_E)|\rangle$ in m$^2$/s.

qace.description: Absolute across-crest elongation-mode flux $\langle |Q_{\bot}(\alpha_E)|\rangle$ in m$^2$/s.

qha_rdp_dp.description: Directional variability of sand flux: ratio of resultant to total drift potential, $RDP/DP$ (0 = multidirectional, 1 = unidirectional). Undefined where there is no sand flux ($DP = 0$).

sige_sigh.description: Stability of elongating dunes on starved beds $\langle|Q_{\bot}(\alpha_E)|\rangle/\langle|Q_{\bot}(\alpha_H)|\rangle$.

qhab_nl_nc.description: Straightness vs. sinuosity of periodic long-crested dunes on covered bed (bed instability mode, growth in height dominates), asymmetry of migrating dunes $|\langle Q_{\parallel}(\alpha_H)\rangle/\langle Q_{\bot}(\alpha_H)\rangle|$.

qhab_ac_nc.description: Relative balance between growth in height and migration dynamics $|\langle |Q_{\bot}(\alpha_H)|\rangle/\langle Q_{\bot}(\alpha_H)\rangle|$.

ufm.description: Average above-threshold flat-bed friction velocity, normalised by threshold $\langle u_{\ast,f}|u_{\ast,f}>u_{\ast,th}\rangle/u_{\ast,th}$.

uft.description: Fraction of time flat-bed friction velocity is above threshold $T|u_{\ast,f}>u_{\ast,th}/T$.

qhbf.long_name: Fraction of bed-mode flux while flat-bed $u_{\ast,f}>u_{\ast,th}$
qhbf.description: Fraction of bed-mode (migration-mode, $\alpha_H$) crest flux that occurs while the flat-bed friction velocity exceeds threshold, $\sum_{u_{\ast,f}>u_{\ast,th}} n|Q(\alpha_H)| / \sum n|Q(\alpha_H)|$. 0 where crest flux occurs only while the flat bed is below threshold; undefined where there is no crest flux.

qhef.long_name: Fraction of elongation-mode flux while flat-bed $u_{\ast,f}>u_{\ast,th}$
qhef.description: Fraction of elongation-mode ($\alpha_E$) crest flux that occurs while the flat-bed friction velocity exceeds threshold, $\sum_{u_{\ast,f}>u_{\ast,th}} n|Q(\alpha_E)| / \sum n|Q(\alpha_E)|$. 0 where crest flux occurs only while the flat bed is below threshold; undefined where there is no crest flux.
